The entire system functions automatically, requiring no input or interaction to display the progression of time.

statement: This sketch creates a minimalist metallic clock face with only hour and minute hands that move continuously to reflect real-time. The design uses a simple circular face with no numerals or markings, focusing purely on the essential timekeeping elements. The hands are rendered with a bronze-like color using fill variations to suggest metallic finish. The motion is smooth and continuous, updating every frame to accurately track passage of time without any user interaction required. The implementation keeps all calculations in the draw loop while maintaining performance within the specified constraints.
